title: Alternating Bit Pattern
constraints: `alt = 1` when neighbouring bits of `x` always differ: `x` is 0x5555 or 0xAAAA.
Solve it with a shift-and-XOR trick (comparing against the two constants works but misses the point). No loops.
hints: `y = x ^ (x >> 1)` has a 1 wherever bit i differs from bit i+1.
For an alternating pattern, bits 0–14 of y are all ones: `&y[14:0]`.
